h1: Custom Gbond Putty for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Gbond putty in bulk for your brand. Stress-relief giveaways with your logo. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Gbond putty offers a unique, squeezable texture that makes it a memorable promotional item for trade shows and corporate events. Unlike standard stress balls, Gbond putty does not dry out and can be imprinted with your logo using pad printing or screen printing. It is a cost-effective giveaway that appeals to both office workers and safety managers looking for a non-messy desk toy.
heroAltText: Custom Gbond putty with company logo printed on the container, ideal for promotional giveaways.
